facts.fact: Safaricom PLC of Kenya injected KES 21.3 billion into Safaricom Ethiopia during the year to March 2026, lifting its stake from 51.3% to 54.1% (Tech-ish); the financier is Kenyan, the recipient a private telecoms operator in Ethiopia.
facts.system: Safaricom PLC capital injection into Safaricom Ethiopia

systems.owner: Global Partnership for Ethiopia consortium (Safaricom PLC 54.1%, Sumitomo 23.5%, BII 9.5%, IFC 6.81%, Vodacom 6.02%)
